test_cases.summary:
Verify Popup opens on right-click
when the Annotation page is loaded with an editable image
test_cases.description:
Feature: Annotation label popup on right-click
Scenario: Popup opens on right-click
Given the Annotation page is loaded with an editable image
When the user right-clicks on the image
Then the label selection popup should appear
test_cases.acceptance:
The label selection popup should appear
The behavior should be validated when the user right-clicks on the image.

test_cases.summary:

test_cases.description:

Given the popup is opened

Then search field, label list, and Apply button should be displayed
test_cases.acceptance:
Search field, label list, and Apply button should be displayed
The behavior should be validated when the popup loads.

test_cases.acceptance:

test_cases.acceptance:
